permission.mode.boundary_text: Tiers are enforced by the core permission gate together with the local runtime sandbox. The permission gate only constrains tool calls reported over the protocol; in-process adapter behavior (including commands it executes itself) is not constrained by this gate (trust-level, not a sandbox). "Full access" = the runtime can read/write any path, execute commands, and access the network; the "View only / Modify in workspace" tiers do not open command and network channels through this gate (in-process adapter behavior is not constrained by this gate).
